capabilities_done: render-cpu plan_sink/filter.rs: ExtOperator::Filter(kind) declared with pigment's class (extension_exactness -> intrinsic, approximate); each stage is one pigment filter_math::filter_window call (render-cpu keeps no filter formula, noise generator or median); content WITHOUT the layer mask is stage 0 (new Eval::frame_content_raw, frame_content = raw + mask); stage windows derived backwards R(k-1) = grow(Rk, reach_k) clipped to B(k-1), B(k) = grow(B(k-1), growth_k) (growth = blur support or median radius, 0 for unsharp/high pass/noise); evaluated per chunk on the chunk-level frame; composited by the normal path so mask (feather/invert/density), Blend-If, mode and opacity*fill apply after the filters; with a mask the composite covers the mask plane only; ExtPrep filters table + FilterLayer growth, frame_shape sizes the frame and charges the sum of pigment filter_window_cost bytes over the stages, filter_work_limit above MAX_EFFECT_WINDOW_WORK, filter_nested when the chunk-level frame is in use, defence in depth InvalidPlan(FilterCombination | FilterParameter)

render-gpu: ExtOperator::Filter(kind) declared (approximate); new filter.wgsl (entry filter_pass, FXC-safe: no dynamic vector component indexing) over the blur bind layout with unsharp and high-pass combine, median (bounded radius 7) and noise passes; gaussian blur and the blur half of unsharp/high pass reuse blur.wgsl with pigment taps; content without the mask rendered one level below (render_content), stage passes over the frame, then composite with mask/Blend-If/mode/opacity (mask plane only, as render-cpu); frame margin = sum of stage reaches; noise: SplitMix64 hash of (seed, x, y, channel, draw) exact via u32 pairs, uniform = top 24 bits in binary32; filter params written into the blur parameter buffer, blur buffers A/B reused (has_blur set for filtered layers, pass_ops bounded)
descriptor keys filters added to render-cpu and render-gpu DESCRIPTOR

notes.tests_detail: render-cpu cpu_filters 4/4: every_filter_matches_pigment_for_every_chunking_and_thread_count (7 cases x chunkings (1,1) (3,1) (5,4) (64,1) (4,8), to_bits equal to filter_window stage by stage), filters_apply_before_the_layer_mask (masked, 7 cases x 3 chunkings), hostile_radii_and_parameters_are_typed_before_any_sink_call (radius 0 blur parity, six out-of-range parameter kinds and 17 filters = PlanError::FilterParameter, median 500 = filter_work_limit, high pass 1000 parity + peak-1 BudgetExceeded), refusals_budget_and_nesting_are_typed_before_any_sink_call (each kind refused under its key at Exact, filters+blur = FilterCombination, peak-1 BudgetExceeded, filter_nested); render-gpu gpu_filters 3/3 on a live adapter (NVIDIA per earlier render-gpu lane notes; which adapter ran this lane's tests: NOT_INSPECTED): gpu_filters_match_pigment_within_tolerance (9 cases x masked/unmasked x chunk sides 8 and 64, max |delta| alpha/premultiplied colour 1.19e-7 worst, tolerance 2e-5), gpu_noise_follows_the_seed, gpu_filter_admission_and_refusals_are_typed (no adapter needed except the median-8 case, which accepts the no-adapter state). regression: cpu_blur 3/3, cpu_transform 4/4, gpu_blur 2/2, render-cpu lib and render-gpu lib refusal_keys tests green (run at e029861/5556fe9)
notes.gpu_proof: gate per tests/gpu-proof.toml (require_gpu = true); no adapter = the parity tests fail with NOT_PROVEN: no adapter, never skipped as pass (V4-03)
notes.gpu_limits: median radius at most 7 (pigment admits 1..500): larger = typed Unsupported filter_median_radius from prepare, before any device work (the CPU backend runs radius up to the work limit: a 20 x 16 window up to radius 499); noise coordinates must fit i32 (filter_coordinates); noise values differ from the reference by at most 2^-24 times the amplitude (24-bit uniform), the hash sequence is exact; unsharp threshold comparison in binary32 can fall on the other side for a pixel exactly on the threshold; gaussian/unsharp/high pass use blur.wgsl taps (BLUR_MAX_TAPS) accumulated in binary32
notes.cpu_limits: stage window work above MAX_EFFECT_WINDOW_WORK (1e9) is filter_work_limit (median radius 500 on a 20 x 16 chunk window = 1.005e9); a filtered layer inside a layer that uses the chunk-level frame (effects, blur, filters) is filter_nested; a mask limits the composited window to the mask plane (blur/median spread beyond the plane is not composited, on both backends)
notes.retry_guard_route: route (a) three times (commit of the product change, then rerun): 1) first hostile test timeout (test assumed a 64 px chunk window), 2) FXC abort of filter.wgsl (dynamic vector indexing), 3) hostile test radius-1000 expectation. Existing kernel creation does not turn this into the typed pipeline failure: follow-up candidate for the gpu lane owner (not changed here)
